scope: Independent execution of two final-room witnesses, local counterfactuals, bank counts and bounded direct-access families

levels.title: Le relais des trois rives

constraints.interpretation: One permanent support is reused along the three recorded water arms; no extra crate is sunk by this witness. The west-bank import alternative shows that the order of every crossing is not mandatory.
ACTION5 is refused before its command is weighted; reversing the extraction remains legal and restores the original reserve.

branches.label: rescue-before-its-command
branches.meaning: Avant le dépôt sur la commande jaune, la porte coupe le rayon de secours ; le reflet est refusé et le Magicien reste sur son îlot.

branches.label: ordinary-departure-loses-the-only-dry-weight
branches.meaning: Un pas volontaire du Barde retire la caisse de la commande et change sa distance de reflet. Le reflet suivant la fait couler à côté de l’île et ne sauve pas le Magicien.

branches.label: press-before-the-double-reflection
branches.meaning: Atteindre prématurément la commande de presse déplace le miroir avant le dépôt sur l’île. Cette tentative de reflet ne remplit aucune des deux commandes finales.

branches.label: shift-the-ferry-before-the-wizard
branches.meaning: Un décalage supplémentaire du chant éloigne l’appui du passage choisi par le Magicien ; son pas direct vers l’eau est refusé.

branches.label: bard-arrival-moves-the-wizard-off-his-goal
branches.meaning: Cette variante est légale mais ne termine pas la salle : en arrivant après son partenaire, le Barde le déplace hors de sa destination. Le Magicien reste jouable pour corriger sa place.

branches.label: west-bank-import-before-moving-the-support
branches.meaning: Legal local alternative: extract the crate from the western bank before moving the support toward the eastern bank. It does not by itself rescue the Wizard or fill the final commands.

branches.label: reverse-the-extraction
branches.meaning: The trapped Wizard can reverse his own substitution. This returns the dry crate to its reserve; it is a legal retreat, not a successful rescue retaining the extracted crate.

branches.label: leave-the-yellow-command-along-its-wall
branches.meaning: A northward Bard step is legal: the wall holds the crate on the command, and the subsequent double reflection still succeeds.

branches.label: correct-the-legal-alternate-goal-order
branches.meaning: The alternate goal order is not a dead end: selecting the Wizard and walking up/left repairs the displacement and wins.

legalAlternatives: Western extraction before moving the support
Reverse the extraction to recover the original position
Northward Bard departure held by the wall before the double reflection
Alternate goal order followed by a three-input repair

levels.title: Le compte des deux rives

constraints.definition: Living heroes, dry crates and monsters; west x≤8, river x9–10, east x≥11. Supports and fixed mirrors excluded.
constraints.interpretation: Every executed substitution preserves the count in each region. Walking/song changes these counts, and the deliberate immersion removes one dry occupant.
Closing the prepared press sinks its loaded crate. Closing it empty is legal and creates no support.

branches.label: walking-away-withdraws-the-first-bridge
branches.meaning: Le départ volontaire du Barde entraîne les gardiens et retire les deux cases du pont provisoire.

branches.label: ordinary-loading-exit-moves-cargo-and-support
branches.meaning: Le départ sud est légal mais déplace la caisse hors de la presse et décale aussi le premier appui. La préparation n’est plus celle du dépôt latéral.

branches.label: unload-the-command-before-loading-the-press
branches.meaning: Retirer la caisse occidentale avant le chargement ferme une presse vide : aucun second appui n’est créé. Une nouvelle préparation reste possible.

branches.label: straight-delivery-carries-away-the-return-support
branches.meaning: La livraison directe place bien la caisse mais emporte un appui jusqu’au nord. Le détour latéral du parcours conserve les deux cases du passage de retour.

branches.label: global-reflection-is-not-the-two-bend-spell
branches.meaning: L’activation globale des miroirs est refusée ici. La flèche du Magicien suit les deux faces et échange les héros ; ACTION5 ne relaie pas les reflets entre miroirs.

branches.label: ordinary-final-exit-removes-the-living-weights
branches.meaning: Un dernier pas chanté retire les deux gardiens de leurs commandes finales et referme la chambre.

branches.label: straight-ray-selects-the-guard-before-the-bard
branches.meaning: La visée horizontale atteint d’abord le gardien droit. Le Magicien le remplace momentanément, puis son départ libère la commande ; le rayon coudé par l’atelier évite cette cible intermédiaire.

branches.label: wrong-final-exit-realigns-the-bridge-with-the-closed-press
branches.meaning: Un départ sud du Barde ramène les appuis devant la presse fermée. Le Magicien franchit l’eau, mais son pas vers la rive orientale est alors refusé.

branches.label: repair-the-voluntary-final-choir-departure
branches.meaning: The southward departure closes the chamber but remains reversible: the next northward song restores both living weights and reopens it.

legalAlternatives: An early empty-press closure can be prepared again
Direct cargo delivery is legal but moves a return support
A voluntary departure from the final choir can be reversed with an opposite step

limits: Five constraints per finale are reviewed. Witness execution is evidence of one route, not minimum length, uniqueness or global ability necessity.
Branch outcomes distinguish legal moves, refused inputs and hero deaths. A legal non-winning branch is not declared a dead end.
Each direct-access case has a 3000 ms and 1500-state limit. A limit is explicitly inconclusive.
Direct-access enumeration fixes cargo, supports, mirrors and the partner during the approach, then executes one real ray, reflection or step. Exhaustion applies only to this stated local family.
No game rule, map, witness, UI or core is modified by this review.
